scope: Canvas main menu local high fidelity only (expanded and forced read-only states, English/简体中文, Light/Dark). Implementation, browser and native acceptance remain separate.

source.exportMethod: Owner supplied official Penpot Web UI download (Main menu → File → Download Penpot file): excalidraw-desktop-uxui-redesign-1791596924.penpot; archived byte-for-byte.
source.contentChecks: 6 boards carry the host up/down select chevrons and no SDK caret; zh boards carry 在画布上查找/主题; forced read-only boards carry disabled rows.

measurementBasis: Menu geometry, colours, type and icons measured from the live @excalidraw/excalidraw 0.18.1 MainMenu in Chromium at 1280×760; SDK icons copied as SVG, not redrawn. Shell top layer reused from approved HF-2 boards 02 (Light) and 06 (Dark, re-laid out to Hidden sidebar) as a 2x raster.
fontProxy: Penpot lacks PingFang SC; Chinese text uses Noto Sans SC as a rendering proxy. The SDK menu font is Assistant; WebKit falls back to the system CJK font at runtime.
